name: PC Mastercard

apr.notes: Standard rates: 21.99% on purchases; 22.97% on cash advances (21.97% in Quebec).

credit_required.notes: Canadian resident who has reached the age of majority; subject to credit approval.

base_rate.description: 10 points per $1 (1% back) on dining, transit and everywhere else.

categories.label: Shoppers Drug Mart and Pharmaprix (2.5% back)

rewards.redemption_notes: PC Optimum points redeem instantly in stores and in the app, or to pay down the card balance.

notes: The issuer page does not name a network package tier, so network_tier is none. Earn rates are shown on the page as percent back in PC Optimum points; 10 points per $1 equals 1% back, so rates are recorded as points per $1. Gas earns points per litre at Esso and Mobil stations, which is not a per-dollar rate.
